Adjacency Matrix

Source: vignettes/adjacency_matrix.Rmd
adjacency_matrix.Rmd

Load packages

library(tidyverse)
library(rebeltrack)

Load Dataset

dataset <- rebeltrack_load_dataset(type = UCDP_STATE_BASED)

Create RebelTrack DataFrame

data <- rebeltrack_dataframe(dataset,
                             side = SIDE_B,
                             period = "month",
                             balanced = TRUE)
data
## An object of class "RebelTrackDataFrame"
## Slot "data":
## # A tibble: 110,316 x 4
##    actor period_start period_end active
##    <int> <date>       <date>     <lgl> 
##  1     3 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  2    21 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  3    84 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  4    97 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  5    98 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  6   112 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  7   116 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  8   125 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
##  9   142 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
## 10   147 1989-01-01   1989-01-31 FALSE 
## # ... with 110,306 more rows

Calculate Adjacency Matrix

adjacency_matrix <- rebeltrack_adjacency_matrix(data)

dim(adjacency_matrix)
## [1] 317 317 348

Apply Adjacency Matrix

data <- data %>%
  rebeltrack_event_count(event_count, weight = adjacency_matrix)

data
